newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Tradewinds to buy plantation co.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Tradewinds to buy plantation co.

text.p: Plantations firm Tradewinds (M) Bhd on Wednesday announced it as signed a deal to acquire Binu Plantations Sdn Bhd for 101.81 million ringgit.

It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) that it will buy 16.7 million shares, or the entire equity, from Binu's owners Pernas Securities Sdn Bhd under the share sale agreeement.

Binu Plantations owns 13,168 acres of oil palm plantation land in east Malaysian state of Sarawak. About 11,800 is planted with oil palm trees, of which 4,000 hectares has matured and ready to contribute to the company's earnings, Tradewinds said.
